  integer, parameter :: m = n/4
  integer :: sendcounts(size), recvcounts(size)
  integer :: displs(size), senddispls(size), recvdispls(size)
  integer :: a(m,n), b(n,m), c(m,m)

                    MPI_INTEGER, a(displs(rank)+1:displs(rank+1)), &
                    recvcounts(rank), MPI_INTEGER, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD, ierr)

  ! Compute the matrix product c = a*b

  end do

  ! Gather the results back to rank 0

- Shivering: The body generates heat through the involuntary muscle contractions of shivering.

- Increased respiration: Breathing rate may increase to take in more warm air.
